sections.kicker: Prepared for Casa Colora by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Casa Colora has a belief about children and creativity. It appears once, in a pinned post.
sections.keep: The logo and the house shape. The rounded wordmark in a brown house is friendly and easy to spot on the grid.

pins.what: The bio speaks Spanish and the tagline switches to English.
pins.why: Parents in San Pedro read two languages in one profile, so the voice is unclear.
pins.how: Choose the language of the brand and use it in tiles and captions.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The brand feels borrowed from somewhere else.

pins.quote: En Casa Colora creemos que la creatividad no se enseña
pins.what: The belief that makes Casa Colora different lives in one pinned caption.
pins.why: It says creativity is explored, not taught, and that is why this studio and not the one next door.
pins.how: Turn this line into the bio and the first words on the grid.
pins.label: Your pinned post
pins.cost: It is the only post that explains the studio, and it will scroll out of sight.

pins.why: Casa Colora, Colora and CasaColora show up in captions and tiles.
pins.how: Pick the full name and use it everywhere.
pins.label: Your name
pins.cost: A short name nobody agreed on is hard to remember.
